industry.structure: Oligopolistic licensed gaming in Macau (six concessionaires) and concentrated premium Strip operators in Las Vegas; high capital barriers and concession scarcity limit new entry.
industry.share_shift: Wynn gained Macau share in Q1 2026 as Wynn Palace VIP and mass table win rose; Las Vegas stable on premium mix; regional operators (LVS, MGM) compete on mass versus Wynn's luxury niche.
industry.trend: Macau GGR recovery accelerating into 2026; U.S. sports betting expansion (Boston licensed); UAE greenfield integrated resorts (Wynn Al Marjan) add Middle East optionality; leverage and interest expense remain sector headwinds.
